# SRJ Global Technologies

> Premier IT Consulting, Custom Software Engineering & Game Development Agency.
> Headquartered in Noida (Delhi NCR), India, serving enterprise and startup clients globally.
> Website: https://srjglobaltechnology.com

## Company Overview
SRJ Global Technologies is a technology solutions provider specializing in full-cycle software development, enterprise digital transformation, AI/ML integrations, and game engineering.

- **Founding / Status**: Established Global IT Services Agency
- **Headquarters**: C-1101, Urbtech Trade Center Tower, Noida Sector-132, Uttar Pradesh 201304, India
- **Email**: srjglobaltechnology@gmail.com
- **Phone**: +91 99904 30305 / +91 92667 06599
- **Certifications & Standards**: ISO 9001:2015, ISO/IEC 27001 Certified, GDPR Compliant, Enterprise SLA (99.9% Uptime)

## Core Capabilities & Services

### 1. Game Development & Gaming Platforms
- **Specializations**: Real-Money Games (RMG), Multiplayer Card Games, Casino Games, Board Games, Unity 3D & Unreal Engine Development.
- **Titles / Frameworks**: Poker, Rummy, Teen Patti, Blackjack, Baccarat, Roulette, Andar Bahar, Dragon Tiger, Aviator, Crash Game, Colour Prediction, Spin Wheel, Ludo, Matka.
- **Features**: Certified RNG (Random Number Generator), anti-fraud shields, low-latency WebSocket multiplayer networking, multi-currency wallet integration.

### 2. Custom Software & Web Development
- High-performance frontend engineering (React.js, Next.js, Vue.js, Tailwind CSS).
- Resilient backend architectures (Node.js, Express, Python FastAPI, Go, Java Spring Boot).
- Microservices, RESTful APIs, and GraphQL.
- Database engineering (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis caching).

### 3. Mobile App Development
- Native iOS (Swift) & Android (Kotlin).
- Cross-platform hybrid applications (Flutter, React Native).
- Enterprise mobile security and offline synchronization.

### 4. AI & Machine Learning Solutions
- Generative AI integrations, intelligent customer service chatbots, conversational agents.
- Predictive analytics, workflow automation, and Computer Vision solutions.

### 5. Cloud Architecture & DevOps
- Cloud infrastructure management (AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure).
- Docker containerization, Kubernetes orchestration, CI/CD automated deployment pipelines.
- 24/7 uptime monitoring, penetration testing, and load-balancing.

## Industry Solutions
- **Gaming & Entertainment**: Multiplayer lobbies, tournament engines, wallet architectures.
- **FinTech & Banking**: Payment gateway integrations, ledger accounting, KYC automation.
- **E-Commerce & Retail**: Multi-vendor marketplaces, inventory sync, recommendation engines.
- **Healthcare & MedTech**: HIPAA-compliant telemedicine, patient record management (EHR/EMR).
- **EdTech**: Learning Management Systems (LMS), interactive virtual classrooms.
- **Real Estate & PropTech**: Property listing engines, CRM workflows, virtual walkthroughs.

## Engagement & Collaboration Models
- **Fixed-Scope Project**: Milestone-based delivery for well-defined requirements.
- **Dedicated Developer / Team (Staff Augmentation)**: Monthly dedicated senior engineering pods.
- **Time & Material (Agile Sprint)**: Flexible iterative development for evolving product scopes.
- **Startup MVP Acceleration**: Rapid prototype development from ideation to production in 4 to 8 weeks.
